name: Erik Johansson
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport HR was a roundabout one. He started his career in the Swedish military, honing his organizational and people management skills. After a decade of service, he transitioned to the corporate world, initially working in HR for a large engineering firm. However, his lifelong passion for racing led him to seek opportunities within the motorsport industry.

He joined Toyota Gazoo Racing five years ago and has since become an invaluable asset, known for his meticulous approach to recruitment and his unwavering commitment to fostering a positive team environment. Erik believes in building a strong team culture based on trust, respect, and open communication. He is particularly adept at identifying and nurturing young talent, ensuring the team has a pipeline of skilled personnel for the future.

Erik is distinctive for his ability to blend his military precision with a genuine empathy for his colleagues. He is a stickler for rules and regulations, but also a compassionate leader who always puts the well-being of his team first. His dedication to Toyota Gazoo Racing is absolute, and he is deeply respected by everyone in the organization.

physical.description: Erik is a man of medium height with a sturdy build, reflecting his military background.

quirks: Always has a supply of Swedish licorice in his desk drawer.
Insists on addressing everyone by their full name, even after years of working together.
Uses military jargon in everyday conversations, often without realizing it.
